name: SJVN Ltd
title: SJVN Ltd - 533206 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: SJVN's FY26 PAT was flat at INR 1,008 crore, with Q4 lifted by a one-off INR 679 crore tariff true-up; new Buxar thermal and solar are loss-making until PLF and CUF ramp, and management has put its 25 GW target under review.

summary.headline: SJVN FY26 PAT rose 4% to INR 1,008 crore on a one-time tariff true-up, while Q4 PAT jumped to INR 125 crore, helped by INR 679 crore of prior-year sales recognition.
summary.overview: FY26 revenue from operations rose about 22% to INR 3,545 crore, driven by INR 679 crore of prior-period sales from tariff true-up for 2019-24 at Nathpa Jhakri and Rampur, plus provisional 2024-29 tariff for Rampur. Finance cost rose 26% to INR 910 crore, including INR 206 crore of exchange rate variation, and depreciation and impairment rose to INR 632 crore including INR 174 crore impairment under Ind AS 36. Subsidiaries drove losses: SGEL lost INR 258 crore on revenue of INR 510 crore, and Buxar Unit-1 (STPL) lost about INR 93 crore in its first three months. Unbilled receivables jumped to INR 906 crore, with INR 776 crore tied to the late-March 2026 tariff order.

segments.name: Hydro (Nathpa Jhakri, Rampur)
segments.commentary: Nathpa Jhakri (1,500 MW) generated 7,506 MU in FY26 vs 7,421 MU; Rampur (412 MW) generated 2,108 MU vs 2,074 MU. Total company generation was 13,302 MU vs 10,646 MU, up about 25%.

segments.name: SGEL (solar subsidiary)
segments.commentary: FY26 revenue INR 510 crore (vs INR 232 crore), expenses INR 802 crore, loss INR 258 crore (vs INR 151 crore loss). Management cited lower CUF on some plants and Bikaner ramp-up after December 2025 COD.

segments.name: Buxar Thermal (STPL, 660 MW Unit-1)
segments.commentary: Unit-1 COD on 14 Nov 2025; about three months of operations gave revenue INR 522 crore, expenses INR 644 crore and total comprehensive loss about INR 93 crore. PLF about 60%; management says profit starts above about 70% PLF.

guidance_outlook: FY27 capacity addition planned at about 2,284 MW: Buxar Unit-2 (660 MW, COD expected end-May 2026), Dhaulasidh hydro (69.5 MW, March 2027) and about 1,555 MW solar from May 2026 to March 2027.
FY28 solar addition of about 650 MW; hydro commissioning scheduled FY29-FY30 (about 2,500 MW).
Nepal Arun-III (900 MW, four units) targeted for full commissioning by December 2028 after dam geological issues were addressed.
Capex plan of about INR 9,400 crore in FY27, INR 7,800 crore in FY28 and INR 7,500 crore in FY29.
Management says it is reviewing the earlier 25,000 MW by 2030 and 50,000 MW by 2040 targets; a new business plan will be released soon.
Buxar expected to turn profitable in FY27 once PLF rises above about 70%.
Dividend of INR 1.5 per share for FY26 subject to approval.
capex_capacity: Operational capacity 4,196.5 MW across 15 projects after FY26 additions of 1,730 MW (1,070 MW solar, 660 MW thermal).
Bikaner 1,000 MW solar commissioned 24 Dec 2025; about 120 MW curtailed due to SVR (reactor) delay, with SVR expected by October 2026.
Dhubri (Assam) solar commissioned 5 Feb 2026, about 141 MU per year at INR 3.92 per unit; Khawada (Gujarat) about 300 MW may face connectivity-related curtailment.
Under construction: 1,561.5 MW hydro, Buxar Unit-2 (660 MW) and 10 solar projects totalling 1,705 MW, for 3,926.5 MW in total.
Buxar Unit-1 capitalised cost about INR 7,000 crore; regulated equity about INR 2,000-2,100 crore, rising to about INR 4,000 crore after both units.
demand_pricing: SJVN as REIA has awarded about 16 GW of RE projects and signed PSAs for about 6 GW; about 9 GW remains unsigned.

Of the unsigned balance, about 2.5 GW is pure solar, about 0.9 GW is solar plus BESS, and the rest is FDRE and hybrid. Management says DISCOMs' adequacy plans and falling tariffs (solar bids at INR 2.53-2.54 vs new bids around INR 2.8-2.9) are causing PPA delays.
FY26 awards: 4 GW capacity, 850 MW solar in Gujarat (16 Oct 2025), 2,000 MWh BESS across Uttar Pradesh and Haryana; PSAs of about 2,177 MW signed in FY26.
Management expects demand to shift toward solar plus BESS and FDRE configurations rather than fall overall.
Secondary energy incentive up 20% in FY26 (16% in Q4); PAF-based incentive -23% in FY26 (-40% in Q4); deviation charges -3% in FY26 and 0% in Q4.

qa_highlights.question: Why is the consolidated result a loss, and is it due to new Buxar revenue at lower PAF and tariff?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said SGEL lost about INR 257 crore and STPL (Buxar) about INR 92 crore. Buxar ran at about 60% PLF and about 70% PAF; SGEL had lower CUF on some plants and Bikaner is still ramping. Finance cost and depreciation are already being charged, so losses should narrow in FY27.

qa_highlights.question: What is the regulated equity for Buxar post-commissioning and what is design energy?
qa_highlights.answer: Regulated equity is about INR 2,000-2,100 crore for Unit-1 (capitalised cost about INR 7,000 crore), rising to about INR 4,000 crore after both units. Design energy is about 9,800 MU for the full plant (about 4,900 MU per unit).

qa_highlights.question: Is there a slowdown in renewable tendering, and what is the status of the roughly 40 GW unsigned PPAs?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said many tenders came out together and DISCOMs' demand is lower than tendered; about 25-30% of capacity is signed across agencies. It expects demand to remain, with a shift toward FDRE and solar plus BESS.

qa_highlights.question: Is the 25,000 MW by 2030 and 50,000 MW by 2040 target still valid, and how will capex be funded?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the targets are under review because projects slipped and new CPSU/VGF tenders did not come as expected. A new business plan will be released soon. Capex is about INR 9,400 crore in FY27, INR 7,800 crore in FY28 and INR 7,500 crore in FY29; funding details were not given.

qa_highlights.question: Are solar plants facing curtailment, and how is it being addressed?
qa_highlights.answer: Bikaner has about 120 MW of curtailment due to the SVR reactor, with delivery expected October 2026 because of a limited manufacturer base. About 300 MW at Khawada may face curtailment from transmission delays. Other plants show no curtailment.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the 9 GW unsigned PPA can be converted?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it was very difficult to estimate. It is pursuing DISCOMs, and it is hopeful that pure solar capacity can also be sold given that tariffs are now higher than earlier bids.

risks_watch: Buxar Unit-2 COD (expected end-May 2026) and Unit-1 PLF rising above about 70% to reach profitability.
Bikaner curtailment (about 120 MW) until SVR delivery in October 2026; possible about 300 MW curtailment at Khawada.
About 9 GW of RE capacity without PSAs; risk of cancellation given falling tariffs.
Receivables: unbilled revenue INR 906 crore including INR 776 crore pending billing in FY27; collection quality matters.
Impairment (INR 174 crore) and forex-driven finance cost (INR 206 crore) could recur; FY26 PAT growth was flattered by one-time tariff true-up.
Revised long-term capacity targets (25 GW by 2030, 50 GW by 2040) pending in the new business plan.
Nepal Arun-III geological and stabilisation issues on dam right bank; commissioning targeted by December 2028.
summary.management_tone: Confident on operational milestones and hydro generation, but notably cautious and evasive on the 25 GW and 50 GW targets, which management is reviewing. It was also non-committal on how many of the 9 GW unsigned PPAs will convert.

So, there will be demand, definitely. I don't see there will not be demand, but maybe with a different configuration like solar plus BESS, maybe FDRE which comprises of solar plus wind plus BESS.

adds.what: about 1,555 MW solar, May 2026 to March 2027

growth.why: FY27 adds about 2,284 MW (Buxar Unit-2 660 MW, Dhaulasidh 69.5 MW, ~1,555 MW solar) and FY28 ~650 MW solar, with capex of ~INR 9,400 crore in FY27, but no explicit revenue growth guidance; Q4 revenue growth of ~109% was inflated by INR 679 crore prior-year tariff true-up, and Buxar Unit-1 runs at ~60% PLF and is loss-making.
